question: What did the controlled wetland trial find about dissolved nitrogen removal and invertebrate richness?

required_claims.text: The planted cells removed more dissolved nitrogen than the unplanted controls.
required_claims.required_exact_quote: Across six weekly samples, planted wetland cells removed 31 percent more dissolved nitrogen than unplanted control cells.

required_claims.text: Macroinvertebrate richness did not differ detectably between the two arms.
required_claims.required_exact_quote: Macroinvertebrate richness showed no detectable difference between planted and control cells during the trial.
